topic: Greenhouse Effect and Enhanced Global Warming
key_concepts: Natural climate drivers include orbital changes, volcanism, and solar activity.
A greenhouse traps heat because its glass walls capture the Sun's heat.
Earth's atmosphere traps heat similarly to greenhouse glass.
Incoming solar radiation is partly reflected or absorbed by clouds and atmosphere.
Earth's surface absorbs solar energy and releases heat back toward space.
Greenhouse gases capture and retain most of Earth's outgoing heat.
